content_sections.heading: About the CMHO Office, Dantewada
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical and Health Officer is the district health office for Dakshin Bastar Dantewada in Chhattisgarh. The Collector of Dantewada approved this hiring. The post is for the District Hospital, which the Health Department runs, and the money comes from the District Mineral Trust Fund (DMF). The aim is to keep health services running smoothly.

content_sections.heading: Dantewada Paediatric Specialist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Qualification (as printed): M.D./D.N.B., with live registration of the MBBS course and the Post Graduation (MD) course in Paediatrics. Experience: if you have experience, attach the certificate. Only experience in the relevant field at a government or semi-government institution counts. Your qualification must be from a recognised university. Within three months of joining, you must submit your Chhattisgarh Medical Council registration. You cannot be selected if a government or semi-government employer removed you on misconduct charges, blacklisted you, or refused to extend your service because of poor work. If you work at a government or semi-government institution, attach a photocopy of a No Objection Certificate from your employer to the application. Check the official notification for the full eligibility for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by a virtual interview. The office uses the details you give in the form to set your interview time and send you the virtual link. A selection committee does the selecting. The Collector of Dakshin Bastar Dantewada approves the committee and it applies the criteria it sets. The decision of the committee chairperson and members is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment follows the Chhattisgarh Civil Service (Contract Appointment) Rules 2012. Leave and other benefits also follow these 2012 rules. The job is fully temporary. Either side can end it with one month's notice under Rule 12 of the Chhattisgarh (Temporary and Quasi-Permanent) Rules. If the office ends it without notice, it pays salary for at least the one-month notice period. After appointment you must sign a 1-year bond. If you break it, Rs. 5,00,000/- will be recovered from you. You must live at the headquarters of your place of posting. Commuting from anywhere else is not allowed, and your service can be ended if you are found doing it. You have no right to a transfer, and no claim to a regular state government post. You can raise no claim or objection during or after the service period, and you get no pension or other payment when the service ends. Your service can be ended at once for unsatisfactory work or misconduct. When you join, you must give a fitness certificate from the District Medical Board. If it says you are unfit, the appointment can be cancelled.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Dantewada Paediatric Specialist Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application form at https://forms.gle/wNKhowLmny9GDyNE8 . Fill in your details and give a mobile number that has WhatsApp. Upload the details of your eligibility. Submit the form by 10.00 AM on 5 November 2026. Wait for your interview time and the virtual interview link from the office, then join the interview on 5 November 2026 from 11.00 AM. Documents: MD/DNB proof, MBBS and MD (Paediatrics) registration, and an experience certificate if you have one. If you are employed at a government or semi-government institution, also attach a photocopy of your employer's NOC. You need the Chhattisgarh Medical Council registration within three months of joining and the District Medical Board fitness certificate when you join.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts does CMHO Dantewada want to fill?
faq.answer: One post: Paediatric Specialist (Shishu Rog Visheshagya) at the District Hospital, Dantewada.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly honorarium?
faq.answer: The vacancy table gives Rs. 3,00,000/- a month and says it is negotiable. Rule 6 of the terms gives Rs. 2,20,000/- a month for a contract medical specialist, with no other allowance.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need?
faq.answer: M.D./D.N.B., with live registration of the MBBS course and the Post Graduation (MD) course in Paediatrics, from a recognised university.

faq.question: Q4. When is the interview, and is it held in person?
faq.answer: It is held online. The virtual interview starts at 11.00 AM on 5 November 2026. The office sends each applicant an interview time and a link.

faq.question: Q5. Why does the form ask for a WhatsApp number?
faq.answer: The notice tells applicants to give a WhatsApp mobile number while filling the form. That is the number the office uses to arrange your online interview.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a service bond?
faq.answer: Yes. After appointment you sign a 1-year bond. If you break it, Rs. 5,00,000/- is recovered from you.

faq.question: Q7. Do I need Chhattisgarh Medical Council registration before I apply?
faq.answer: No. You must submit it within three months of joining after selection.

faq.question: Q8. I work at a government hospital. What else must I send?
faq.answer: Attach a photocopy of a No Objection Certificate from your employer to the application.

faq.question: Q9. Can I live outside Dantewada and commute?
faq.answer: No. You must live at the headquarters of your place of posting. Your service can be ended if you are found commuting from somewhere else.
